description: Execute a data transformation against sample input and return the output. Requires the transform class name, source message class name, and a JSON object of property values to populate the source message. The transformation is executed and the resulting output object is returned.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

sourceData.description: JSON object of property values to populate the source message

name: iris_transform_test
title: Test Data Transformation
